title: Joint defense-skill co-evolution has no convex-hull invariant without an affine mixture construction
dead_end_scope: The standalone SHADOW-P05-C01 formulation whose distinguishing prediction requires the final joint defense-skill (security, utility) point to lie strictly inside the convex hull of the defense-only and skill-only endpoints and requires a positive defense-restrictiveness/skill-diversity squeeze trajectory as a necessary signature of the claimed mutual-constraint plateau.

counter_explanation.statement: The candidate's exact convex-hull prediction is valid only if the joint system is literally a randomized mixture of the two frozen single-arm endpoint policies or if the policy-to-(security, utility) outcome map is affine along the joint update path. Neither condition is implied by HARD, SkillCommit, or generic co-evolution. Joint defense and skill updates change each other's feasible action support and optimization landscape, introducing non-affine interaction cross-terms; therefore the joint reachable point may lie outside the line segment between the two single-arm endpoints. The claimed positive restrictiveness-diversity squeeze is likewise not a structural invariant: stronger defense can contract the executed action support and reduce realized skill diversity.
counter_explanation.opposite_prediction: Under coupled defense-skill dynamics with changing feasible action sets, the joint endpoint may lie outside the two-point convex hull, and defense restrictiveness may be negatively rather than positively associated with executed skill diversity. A generic coupled multi-objective system should therefore not be expected to satisfy the candidate's convex-hull or squeeze signatures unless a separate affine-mixture architecture is explicitly imposed.
counter_explanation.opposite_principle: Coupled multi-objective optimization with endogenous feasible-set changes is non-affine in general. Convex-hull membership of endpoint metrics is guaranteed only by an explicit mixture/affinity construction, not by the fact that two components are individually beneficial or jointly optimized.
counter_explanation.opposite_search_seed: If defense-skill interaction remains interesting, search for a matched 2x2 factorial or another independently manipulable interaction variable that estimates a genuine cross-term under identical information and budget. Do not require convex-hull membership. A valid next object should either identify an architecture-derived invariant of the feasible action set under joint updates or demonstrate a residual interaction beyond a same-information coupled-dynamics model without assuming the sign or geometry in advance.
counter_explanation.scope: SHADOW-P05-C01 / AGENT-SAFETY-DEFENSE-SKILL-CONVEX-HULL-PLATEAU only: the current convex-hull and positive-squeeze realization of a defense-skill mutual-constraint plateau. The broader question of non-additive defense-skill interaction remains open.
alternative_explanations_ruled_out: The dead-end is not authorized by the negative F0 alone. The required convex-hull signature is structurally unjustified before any experiment because no mixture or affine metric map is part of the scientific object.

The defense-only and skill-only endpoints do not span the full set of jointly reachable policies when joint updates change the feasible action set; therefore leaving their line segment does not by itself imply a novel plateau mechanism.

The negative restrictiveness-diversity correlations observed in all three bounded R4 units are consistent with the opposite principle but are supporting evidence only, not the source of the structural conclusion.
Increasing learning rate, exploration noise, or seed count cannot restore a convex-hull invariant absent an affine-mixture construction.

Replacing the endpoint hull with a larger empirical polygon built from more single-arm checkpoints would change the proposed invariant and still would not be guaranteed under non-affine joint updates.
counter_explanation.reopen_condition: Reopen only with a new formulation that drops convex-hull membership as a necessary signature and supplies a preregistered interaction prediction justified by the actual agent architecture. Acceptable routes include a same-information 2x2 factorial cross-term, an independently measured feasible-action-set invariant, or a stated architectural constraint that mathematically forces a specific defense-restrictiveness/skill-diversity relation. More seeds, a different toy domain, or another joint endpoint outside/inside the same hull does not reopen the current realization.

do_not_say: defense and skill evolution do not interact
the R4 experiment falsified all defense-skill composition ideas
coupled dynamics guarantees a specific alternative endpoint
scientific_interpretation.safe_claim: The current defense-skill plateau realization is closed because its decisive convex-hull and positive-squeeze signatures depend on an affine-mixture invariant not supplied by the component systems or by generic coupled dynamics. The broader interaction problem remains open and should be reformulated around an independently justified cross-term or feasible-set invariant rather than endpoint hull geometry.
